title: Embeddable cyclotron: Papyrus integration
description:
Make a cyclotron easy to embed in an application, using Papyrus (the automated newsroom CMS) as the first integration and the public example. Papyrus decides whether a pending Reference candidate is relevant to the publication (classifier 'relevant', labels include/exclude); editors review with thumbs up or down, a reason code and an explanation. Design: project/wiki/papyrus-integration.md. The Papyrus-side epic lives in AnthusAI/Papyrus (project/wiki/cyclotron-integration.md on branch docs/cyclotron-integration). Order of the child tasks: status shape, then SDK, portable store, review-rate program, review control, status widget, package release, recording export, docs. Done when Papyrus decides and reviews through the SDK, shows the review control and status strip from the package, and one recorded Papyrus fixture exists.

## Current next-step plan — 2026-10-17

Priority 1: complete the hosted Cyclotron priming workflow inside Papyrus. Reuse existing Biblicus/Papyrus paper and web curation rather than introducing a second ingestion path. A user pastes a permitted URL, reviews the extracted material, chooses publish or reject, optionally explains the choice, saves, reloads, and can prove that the selected classifier consumes the accepted example. A visible saved card alone is not classifier-consumption evidence.

Feature: Hosted reference priming
  Scenario: Save a published example and consume it after reload
    Given an authorized publication and a supported paper or web URL
    When the editor curates it, chooses publish, optionally explains, saves and reloads
    Then canonical source content and the human label remain in the selected account/publication
    And the next classifier decision exposes the accepted example ID and priming count/context provenance
  Scenario: Reject or retry without creating a false positive
    Given a candidate and an optional blank explanation
    When the editor rejects it or a save fails and is explicitly retried
    Then the recorded choice survives reload without duplicate examples
    And rejected or uncommitted candidates do not silently become positive accepted examples
  Scenario: Deny cross-scope and revoked access
    Given a missing/revoked grant or an account/publication change during a request
    When a save or classifier operation is attempted
    Then authorization is rechecked and stale/cross-scope data is not read or written

Run equivalent observable scenarios in embedded deployment-local and remote central multi-publication modes using the same shared UI. Cloud content is canonical text/files in S3; DynamoDB is a rebuildable scoped catalog. Local SQLite remains supported; no always-on SQLite cloud service. Preserve existing canonical IDs, revision/conflict and replay semantics. Dependency order: shared release/tag and consumer lock/pins; Papyrus PR213 required checks/review; real account/publication BFF and approved storage/runtime scope; then hosted save/reload/classifier evidence. No paid calls during documentation; any later live-model acceptance uses its separately approved budget.

Verified 2026-10-17: Cyclotron PR25 https://github.com/AnthusAI/Cyclotron/pull/25 merged into develop at323d0b587d9057e0e93b99df2383bde70b2edc91, head61323ae0840fb3a787439c09d7a08674ff677aed. Test and diagrams checks SUCCESS; release SKIPPED. Source prepares UI0.2.2, but remote UI tags stop atui-v0.2.1 (peeledb2234be79d83231a4ed69f17a928b5049ab364a4); no ui-v0.2.2 tag. Latest published engine releasev0.20.1 (c09f70b33b2b96a4e4cc2acca360af47d26620a8, published2026-10-12). PR25 is not an ancestor of current main. Merged develop source is not a published dependency or production proof.

The shared priming/storage source portion is merged into develop; keep hosted integration/release acceptance open. Dependencies: Papyrus PPY-7a0ac8/PPY-a8471b/PPY-58f107; Prospectus kanbus-6cf11d42. Shared Anthus publications and embedded DataParade are examples, not hardcoded account names.

Authority: Ryan requested this plan as the permanent Kanbus record. This action updates documentation only. The desired product outcomes are requested priorities, not claims of implementation or hosted acceptance. Existing implementation owners retain their approvals; recommendations needing further scope, release, permission or migration direction stay explicitly gated. No feature code, deployment, paid call, permission change or unrelated merge is performed here.

comments.text: 2026-10-16 reconciliation: Integration remains unfinished. Required modes are a central remote lab with multiple publication classifier outputs and embedded deployment-local storage, sharing monitoring, steering and labeling UI. Anthus shared publications and DataParade embedded are examples. URL-only priming must reuse Papyrus/Biblicus research-paper and web curation, with optional explanations and CSV/JSON/JSONL/spreadsheet/template paths. Adaptercdc70ff, Biblicus1b170876/verification79861bb and Papyrus draft PR213/a7c4d1d are source/prototype evidence, not a production release. Dependencies: Papyrus PPY-58f107, PPY-7a0ac8; Prospectus central account/permission service. Hosted auth/storage and reviewed Cyclotron release/pins remain gates.
